title: Lundey game phase state diagram
description: The phase of the Game. Pausing is a separate flag: a pause press toggles Game.paused in ready and play (never in a demo), and while it is set step() changes nothing, the frame count included. A demo is the same machine with Game.demo set: the page starts one with newGame(true) and feeds it the autopilot's directions, and it goes back to attract when its puffin is caught or its burrow cleared, so a demo never reaches over. Every timed phase counts Game.timer down once a step.

states.description: The title screen. Nothing moves; only the frame count runs, for the title's animation.
Counting in before play: 170 steps at the start of a game, 120 after a caught puffin or a cleared burrow. The puffin's next turn can already be chosen.
The puffin and the hunters move; lasts until the last eel is eaten or the puffin is caught.
A hunter caught the puffin: 120 steps while it spins away.
The last eel was eaten: 170 steps while the island flashes.
No puffins left: the score stays up for 300 steps, or until start is pressed.

transitions.action: newGame(): score 0, three puffins, burrow 1, a new base seed drawn for this game's burrows, loadLevel(); timer = FIRST_READY_STEPS; emit start.

transitions.trigger: newGame(true), called by the page (src/main.ts, step)
transitions.guard: the title screen has stood for DEMO_AFTER steps (twelve seconds)
transitions.action: The same as a real game, with Game.demo set: nothing it scores counts towards the best, and it earns no extra puffin.

transitions.trigger: puffinArrives(): the last eel is eaten
transitions.action: CLEAN_POINTS and a popup if no puffin was lost on this burrow; timer = CLEARED_STEPS; emit clear.

transitions.trigger: touch(): a hunter that is out, and not mobbed, comes within TOUCH of the puffin
transitions.action: lives−−; clean = false; timer = CAUGHT_STEPS; emit caught.

transitions.guard: not a demo, and puffins are left
transitions.action: resetActors(): puffin and hunters back at their starts, the eels as they are; timer = READY_STEPS; emit ready.

transitions.guard: not a demo, and no puffins are left

transitions.action: level++; loadLevel(): a new burrow with all its eels and feathers; timer = READY_STEPS; emit ready.
newGame(): a new game; emit start.
